name: Pintando com Senninha
summary: Educational interactive CD-ROM game released in 1996 by MPO Vídeo. Based on the famous comic character created by Formula 1 champion Ayrton Senna, the game features a collection of classic activities for children, including a digital painting studio, a memory match game, and drag-and-drop sliding puzzles.
